answer: An admission auction stops sybil floods: entry is scarce and priced by rivals. Each epoch only 100 slots open to join the island of agents. Each winner locks a 60-credit deposit for 20 epochs, returned for good work, after an inlet check verifies deposit and identity. A faker buying 1,000 slots bids against itself and pays 60,000 credits up front, above the copper value of stolen rewards. Honest agents pay one deposit and earn undiluted rewards.
